senses.gloss: m. (v. עַכָּבִית) a dish of thistles (Cynara Syriaca), the eating of which generates an evil smell of the body (v. Löw Pfl. p. 292, quot. fr. Dioscorides).
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:12">Lam. R. to IV, 9</cite> <he>היו מתים מריח ע׳</he> they died from the smell of the thistles (which they ate during the siege).
